verdict.rationale: Browserbase advertises '30+ ready-made templates' to start building quickly, which is the closest evidence to a marketplace of pre-built scrapers, but this is framed as starter templates for building agents/browser automations rather than a curated marketplace of finished, run-as-is scrapers. Missing for 10: explicit scraper marketplace, evidence of running a template unmodified to scrape a target site, and any community/hands-on account of using a template instead of coding one.
